title: HR-SWTG3C12F
brief: 10G L3 Management Ethernet Switch. Support 12* SFP+ ports, 1* RJ45 console port. Perfect security control strategy and CPU protect policy, improve product fault tolerance, ensure stable network operation and link load balancing; Support automatic DoS attack prevention, SNMP, IEEE802.1q, spanning tree, rapid generation tree protocol, link aggregation and other functions. Advanced security features and advanced Quality of Service (QoS), can be used as a core, distribution or access layer switch, with high port density, easy to manage, it is an ideal choice for a variety of commercial network applications.
